correctness.rationale: Build a maximally L_Λ-consistent Δ and G={χ:□χ∈Δ}. With cl_Λ(X)={χ: some finite X0⊂X has L_Λ⊢(∧_{ξ∈X0}□ξ)→□χ}, the one-world truth bridge follows in both directions: the singleton support proves one direction, and theorem plus boxed members of Δ proves the other. For M,C,N,K,4 the corresponding axiom schemata compose finite proof supports to establish each chosen closure-member condition. For D, hypothetical χ and ¬χ in the closure yield finite supports whose union and the D axiom contradict Δ consistency. Restriction to an appropriately augmented finite subformula set for a single non-theorem yields a finite G, with the truth bridge needed only on the finite set; a closure of G may remain infinite. All 64 axiom selections are covered with no modal inference rules. This verifies the key construction on its stated non-extensive arbitrary-map semantics; the finite-set canonical details depend on the source’s augmented-subformula lemma.
